meta.strategy: Turn Kestia and other bestow creatures and Auras into enchanted attackers that draw cards, with an enchantress engine fueling a steady stream of enchantments. Voltron Auras, ramp enchantments and efficient removal keep the pressure up, while Winds of Rath wipes the board but spares our enchanted threats.

Atraxa proliferates every end step, scaling poison counters from toxic and infect creatures alongside planeswalker loyalty and +1/+1 counters, with Tekuthal, Vorinclex and Doubling Season multiplying the effect. Efficient ramp, removal and wipes protect the board while proliferate draw engines keep the cards flowing; total spend is about $453.97 of the $474.37 allowed.

Turn creatures into enchantment creatures or suit them up with bestow and auras, so every attack draws cards through Kestia. An enchantress engine and aura ramp fuel huge voltron threats, while cheap exile, aura removal and Winds of Rath keep the board in our favor.

Kestia rides Voltron-style on enchantment creatures and bestowed or aura-buffed threats, drawing a card for every enchanted attacker while enchantresses refill the hand on every cast. Cheap mana auras and enchantment ramp accelerate into big bestow turns, flexible aura removal handles threats, and Winds of Rath wipes the board while sparing our enchanted creatures.

Fill the graveyard with self-mill creatures, then use Muldrotha to replay each permanent type, recurring value creatures, removal enchantments, artifacts and lands every turn. Land recursion with Gitrog, Loam and Ramunap drives card advantage, reanimation spells cheat out threats, and Deed and Deluge reset boards we can rebuild.

Fill the graveyard with self-mill creatures and enchantments, then use Muldrotha to replay sacrifice outlets, removal creatures, lands and enchantments every turn. Value engines like Secrets of the Dead, River Kelpie and Life from the Loam outgrind opponents, while Syr Konrad, recurring edicts and Pernicious Deed control the board.

Fill the graveyard with self-mill and tutor-to-yard effects, then use Muldrotha to replay creatures, artifacts, enchantments, lands and planeswalkers from the graveyard every turn. Recursive value pieces, fetch and sac-lands, and reusable removal grind out the table, while Syr Konrad, Teval and Altar of Dementia supply reach.

Atraxa proliferates every end step, so the deck spreads poison through toxic and infect creatures and adds more proliferate triggers. Planeswalkers, draw engines and efficient removal and wipes keep the board under control while poison counters climb toward ten; picks total $124.30.

Ramp quickly into Krenko, Mob Boss, protect and haste him with Boots, Warchief and Motivator, and grow the goblin count exponentially with cheap token makers. Close the game with Impact Tremors, Goblin Bombardment and mass-damage burn, backed by efficient removal and two board wipes.

Atraxa proliferates every end step, so the deck spreads poison through cheap toxic and infect creatures and multiplies them with proliferate spells, Tekuthal and Ezuri card draw. Budget-friendly mana rocks and land ramp fix four colors, while cheap removal, counterspells and Sunfall/White Sun's Twilight keep the board under control.

Flood the board with Goblins, then untap and accelerate Krenko with haste enablers, lords, tutors and token makers to grow the swarm exponentially. Close out games with Impact Tremors, Kreat, Bombardment and mass pump, backed by Skullclamp draw and cheap red removal.

Cast a dense suite of cheap cantrips, counterspells and bounce to turn every instant and sorcery into a flying Drake through Talrand, with cost reducers and High Tide fuelling big chain turns. Protect the board with counters and Propaganda, then swing with an anthem-pumped air force.

Flood the board with goblins, untap or haste Krenko to grow the swarm exponentially, then convert it into damage with Impact Tremors, Purphoros and Goblin Bombardment. Tutors like Matron, Recruiter and Muxus find the key pieces, while sacrifice outlets double as ramp and removal.

Chain cheap cantrips, counterspells and cost reducers to flood the board with flying Drakes, using anthem effects and combat-draw engines to close games in the air. Free counters, bounce and Cyclonic Rift protect the board while Talrand and the backup token makers keep growing it.

Talrand turns a dense suite of cheap cantrips, counterspells and bounce into a steady stream of flying Drakes, with cost reducers and High Tide fuelling big turns. Card draw engines keep the hand full, interaction protects the board, and Favorable Winds, Alandra and Murmuring Mystic help the air force close out games.

Flood the board with cheap mana elves and token makers, then use Lathril's ten-elf drain, anthems and mass pumps like Ezuri or Overrun to close games. One-sided wipes and cheap Golgari removal keep the board clear while Beast Whisperer, Skullclamp and tribal draw refuel.

Flood the board with cheap mana elves and token makers, using lords and pump spells to make Lathril connect and grow the Elf army. Then win by tapping ten Elves for a 10-point drain, or with Overrun-style alpha strikes and Exsanguinate, backed by cheap removal and one-sided wipes.

Flood the board with mana elves and token makers, then tap ten Elves with Lathril to drain each opponent for 10, or swing with anthems and Craterhoof. One-sided wipes like Kindred Dominance and In Garruk's Wake, plus protection, keep the Elf army intact while flexible removal handles threats.

Flood the board with cheap Vampires so Eminence makes extra tokens, then swing with Edgar to pump the whole team with counters, lords and anthems. Aristocrat payoffs, efficient Mardu removal and one-sided wipes like Olivia's Wrath keep the swarm ahead.

Flood the board with cheap Vampires so Edgar's eminence makes tokens from the command zone, then pump the team with lords and Edgar's attack trigger. Aristocrat drain pieces like Blood Artist and Sanguine Bond plus Exquisite Blood close games, with cheap removal, Vampire-sparing wipes and protection keeping the board safe.

Go wide with cheap Vampires: each one triggers Edgar's eminence for an extra token, and anthems plus Edgar's attack counters turn the swarm lethal. Sac outlets and drain creatures convert the tokens into card draw and incremental life loss, backed by cheap removal and one-sided wipes.

Grist churns out Insect tokens and mills Insects, so the deck runs a dense, cheap Insect suite and graveyard-fueled creatures that grow as the yard fills. Sacrifice outlets feed Grist's −2 removal, recursion spells refill the Insect chain, and big graveyard payoffs set up the −5 to finish opponents.

Grind value with Grist's +1 to flood the board with Insects, while self-mill fuels Insect recursion through Zask, Amzu and reanimation spells. Sacrifice outlets and Skullclamp turn tokens into cards, and Grist's -2 plus cheap interaction control the table until Mazirek, Scute Swarm or Grist's -5 closes the game.

Grist churns out Insect tokens while milling, fueling a graveyard full of insect creatures that synergy pieces like Zask, Amzu and Aatchik turn into value and board presence. Sacrifice outlets, recursion and drain effects like Grave Pact and Meathook convert the swarm into removal, cards and lethal damage alongside Grist's -5.

Esika ramps into a dense suite of cheap legendary creatures and planeswalkers, and her upkeep trigger flips them into play for free while legends become extra mana dorks. Budget removal, Urza's Ruinous Blast and legendary recursion like Primevals' Glorious Rebirth protect and rebuild the legendary board.

Ramp quickly with cheap rocks, dorks and land searches, then let Esika's upkeep trigger flood the board with legendary creatures and planeswalkers. Extra-upkeep effects and trigger doublers like Annie Joins Up, Paradox Haze, Obeka, Sphinx and Strionic Resonator multiply those free creatures, while cheap spot removal and one-sided wipes protect the board.

Ramp quickly into a five-color legendary value engine, letting Esika's upkeep trigger, doubled by Paradox Haze and Sphinx, flip Gods, Atraxas and planeswalker-adjacent threats onto the battlefield for free. Cheap interaction, legendary-friendly wipes like Urza's Ruinous Blast, and recursion via Primevals' Glorious Rebirth keep the board ours.

Flood the board with cheap mana rocks and artifact creatures so Karn's upkeep mana can fund big colorless threats like Wurmcoil, Darksteel Colossus and Myr Battlesphere. Cost reducers, recursion and colorless removal back this up, with All Is Dust and Nevinyrral's Disk as wipes that colorless artifacts shrug off or rebuild from.

Fill the board with cheap artifacts and mana rocks so Karn's upkeep trigger makes huge pools of colorless mana, then spend it on big artifact threats like Darksteel Colossus, Myr Battlesphere and Metalwork Colossus. Forsaken Monument, the Tron lands and colorless removal such as All Is Dust and Karn's Sylex support the plan while keeping the total near $30.85.

Flood the board with artifacts and mana rocks so Karn's upkeep trigger produces huge colorless mana pools for massive artifact threats like Blightsteel, Mycosynth Golem and Darksteel Colossus. Unwinding Clock, Darksteel Forge and Tron lands amplify mana and resilience, while colorless removal, Ugins and All Is Dust handle opponents.
